name: dav1d
recipe_basis: Upstream src/meson.build base C sources and BITDEPTH=8/16 templates, plus src/win32/thread.c on Windows. Source is unmodified. HAVE_ASM=0 is the portable baseline, so MSVC needs neither NASM nor Meson/Ninja. Native code is optimized even in Rust debug builds.
linkage: Static; no dav1d shared library or DLL is needed in release archives.
build_prerequisites: Cargo and the target C compiler (Windows: Visual Studio C++ Build Tools/MSVC; Linux: GCC or Clang and pthread; macOS: Xcode Command Line Tools). No network access is used by the native build.
rust_binding_decision: rust-av/dav1d-sys 0.8.3's internal build clones dav1d 1.5.0 during build and invokes git, Meson, Ninja and pkg-config; it does not supply reproducibly bundled source for the normal MSVC build. A narrow C shim keeps native layouts and custom bounded allocation callbacks out of Rust.
license_file: COPYING inside the archive; reproduced in docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
